reason: Seeds the Channel Monitor V2 factory configuration with popular-model allow-lists so unlisted models can be grouped as other in the presentation layer.
risk: The migration performs a bulk-style UPDATE of the singleton configuration row and could replace a configuration that still exactly matches the original factory JSON.
mitigation: The WHERE clause requires the exact migration-194 factory value, so any operator change to platform order, enabled state, model lists, or platform membership prevents the update. The version is incremented for auditability.
